query:
DELETE FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
           OR s.expires_at < $1
           OR s.last_seen_at < $2
           OR EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM users u
               WHERE u.id = s.user_id
                 AND (u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                      OR (u.deactivated_at IS NOT NULL) <> s.restricted)
           )
